# Kettlebell Academics

> > Professional kettlebell certification, coaching mentorship, and specialized training programs led by Drew Miller, CSCS.

Kettlebell Academics offers the KACS (Kettlebell Academics Coaching Specialist) certification program, professional trainer workshops, and customized kettlebell training programs. Drew Miller provides online mentorship and specialized programming in kettlebell foundations, power, and strength training.

## Key Topics

- KACS 1 (Kettlebell Academics Coaching Specialist)
- Drew Miller, CSCS
- Kettlebell certification and coaching specialist programs
- Online mentorship and remote training
- Program design and customized programming
- Kettlebell Foundations, Power, and Strength programs
- Trainer workshops and professional development
- Movement mastery and kettlebell flow
- KBTS (Kettlebell Training Specialist)
- Fitness coaching and personal training
- Strength training methodology
- 3-month mentorship programs

## Certification & Mentorship

- [COACHING SPECIALIST CERT](https://kettlebellacademics.com/coaching-specialist): KACS 1 certification: 3-month mentorship program with Drew Miller
- [KACS 1 ONLINE MENTORSHIP](https://kettlebellacademics.com/product-page/kacs-1-online-mentorship-1): KACS 1 product page with 3-payment plan option ($497.95/month)
- [TRAINERS WORKSHOPS](https://kettlebellacademics.com/trainers-workshops): Professional workshops for trainers and coaches in kettlebell methods

## Training Programs

- [ONLINE TRAINING](https://kettlebellacademics.com/online-training): Customized remote kettlebell training programs with Drew Miller
- [TRAINING PROGRAMS](https://kettlebellacademics.com/specialty-programs): 12-week programs: Kettlebell Foundations, Power, and Strength training
